keyPoints.hi: गिनने योग्य: many/few; न गिनने योग्य: much/little

keyPoints.en: Reflexive: myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, themselves
keyPoints.hi: Reflexive: myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, themselves

problem.en: Fill in: "How __ sugar do you need?" (many/much)

steps.en: Sugar cannot be counted one by one → uncountable.
steps.hi: चीनी एक-एक गिनी नहीं जाती → uncountable।

steps.en: The action comes back to the same person (she).
steps.hi: काम उसी व्यक्ति (she) पर लौटता है।

question.en: Fill in: "__ shoes over there are mine." (These/Those)
question.hi: भरो: "__ shoes over there are mine." (These/Those)

intro.en: Nouns name things (proper, common, collective, material, abstract). Nouns can be countable (apples) or uncountable (water). Pronouns replace nouns: personal (he), possessive (hers), reflexive (himself) and demonstrative (this, those).
intro.hi: संज्ञा चीज़ों के नाम हैं (proper, common, collective, material, abstract)। संज्ञा गिनने योग्य (apples) या न गिनने योग्य (water) हो सकती है। सर्वनाम संज्ञा की जगह आते हैं: personal (he), possessive (hers), reflexive (himself) और demonstrative (this, those)।
